## Activity

During July 2023, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 105 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month and provides the basis for the quality and grading results reported below. The capture total should be considered alongside the small number of images that could not be assessed and the results requiring referral.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There were 2 ungradable captures, equivalent to an ungradable rate of 1.9 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the referable results. The ungradable total and rate should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and image-quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 20 referable results from the captures completed during July 2023. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates the typical interval for completed grading activity during the reporting period. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a summary of service performance at Oakridge Primary Care for July 2023.
